caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a central section bordered by two horizontal blue bands at the top and bottom. Within each blue band, there are alternating motifs of stylized red flowers with beige outlines and simple beige four-petal shapes, spaced evenly across the band. Between these two blue bands, the central area is filled with a repeating pattern of overlapping maple leaves. The leaves are primarily light beige with some pale grey shading, and each leaf is outlined and veined in red. Separating the central leaf section from the blue floral bands is a slim beige stripe with a row of small red dots running its length. The overall color palette includes beige, red, blue, and pale grey tones. The arrangement is symmetrical and organized, with the leaf pattern and floral bands creating a continuous, decorative design.
title: Wall Paper
